caption_L1: This bar chart is titled Estimated cost per eligible voter for political TV ads and campaigns in the 2014 U.S. midterm elections , by state and political party (in U.S. dollars). The x-axis measures Republicans and allies on linear scale from 0 to 7 while the y-axis measures State using categorical scale with Alaska on one end and Wyoming at the other.
caption_L2L3: Only 4 states exceeded the expenditure of all others - these were Alaska, Arkansas, Iowa and Kentucky. Delaware, Hawaii, Rhode Island and Texas had no expenditure per voter. Illinois, Minnesota, New Mexico, Tennessee and Virginia all had very low expenditures compared to others.
